messages:
maria.g: Heads-up: a chunk of us-west-2 GPU nodes are stuck in PROVISIONING, kubelet never finishes boot because node-agent can't fetch sealed keys from the HSM proxy.

ajay.s: Which HSM proxy endpoint? last night's FW changes landed in prod so could be blocked.

maria.g: hsm-proxy 10.200.5.12:15000. kubelet logs:
```
E0320 03:04:12.123 kubelet.go:142] rpc error: HSM auth failure: handshake timeout (403)
E0320 03:04:12.124 node-agent.go:88] failed to unwrap key: auth denied
```

linus: sec-bot posted a keyring rotation at 02:45, and the rotation job tightened allowed sources to control-plane CIDR only. That would stop nodes in the separate provisioning-subnet from talking to the proxy.

sre-alice: This explains the provisioning backlog. We're currently seeing ~120 pending GPU allocations queuing in the scheduler for us-west-2-gpu-pool. Nodes need that unseal to attach GPU drivers and GPU daemonsets.

maria.g: Can someone open port 15000 from the provisioning-subnet to the hsm-proxy as a temporary unblock? Need quick mitigation — otherwise customers hit OOMs in their inference queues.

ajay.s: I can push a security-group change for the infra-SG but net team owns the global NACLs. I'll open SG ingress for now and raise a NET ticket for the NACL.

ops-bot: NET-4521 created by ajay.s: "Allow 10.0.48.0/20 -> 10.200.5.12:15000 for node bootstrap until keyring rotation completes".

ajay.s: quick test command I ran from a bastion: `curl -v http://10.200.5.12:15000/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 403` before SG change. After adding SG rule returned `200 OK`.

linus: Nice. Command to apply if needed quickly:
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 15000 --cidr 10.0.48.0/20
```

sre-alice: Doing a rolling retry on the stalled nodes now. Will also scale up us-east-1 GPU pool by +8 nodes to absorb backlog while we validate.

maria.g: Partial recovery: 18/24 nodes moved to Ready in the affected ASG. Still seeing audit log gap for 03:00-03:15 where bootstrap events were lost. sec-bot, any idea?

sec-bot: Audit sink to central-logger was briefly disabled by the rotation job at 1719992800 while the rotation rekeyed HSM-proxy TLS certs. Sink re-enabled at 1719992845. Events during the window may need manual replay.

ajay.s: Note on costs: my NET workaround used transit-gw route in the test path which can add cross-AZ data fees — expect ~$0.10-0.15/GB while the exception is active. We should revert to the least-permissive SG change once rotation is stable.

linus: Agreed. Follow-ups: update runbook with explicit step for 'allow-provisioning-subnet' during rotations, record rotation window, and create postmortem. I'll tag NET-4521 and create INFRA-889 for the postmortem. :thumbsup:

maria.g: Thanks everyone — bootstrap backlog cleared, continuing to monitor scheduler. INFRA-889 will capture the audit replay and cost/rollback plan.
thread_text: HSM proxy firewall blocked node bootstrap, caused GPU provisioning backlog; temporary SG fix + transit-gw test; audit sink gap during rotation; follow-ups: NET-4521, INFRA-889
